$description: How EDH Seer expresses the interaction states. THE VOCABULARY IS SMALL AND DELIBERATE: hover changes a colour's ROLE (muted becomes accent), selection moves UP the ground ladder, disabled dims. There are no state-layer overlays - the accent is scarce, and a tinted wash over a surface would spend it on a row that is merely hovered.

default.$description: The base tokens; no state treatment. See tokens/colors.json semantic.

text.$description: `hover:text-(--accent)` - the whole hover vocabulary. A link's underline follows its text.

focus.$description: KEYBOARD ONLY (`:focus-visible`), so a mouse click never paints a ring. Drawn as an outline at 2px offset - it never reflows the control - and the offset flips to -2px inside an overflow-x container, because the scroller clips anything drawn outside a child's box, including its ring.

active.$description: No pressed treatment ships. Recorded rather than invented: adding one is a design decision, not a token lookup.

bg.$description: selection moves UP the ground ladder; the accent is not spent on a selected row

opacity.$description: no colour token - it dims. WCAG exempts disabled controls from the contrast minimum.

loading.$description: LOADING IS NOT DISABLED. Reusing the disabled dim reads as 'you cannot do this' rather than 'this is happening': the control keeps full strength and swaps its label for a spinner.
